candidate_reports.remark: Photos received of a large tree blown down onto a home. Minor injuries were reported as roof caved in from the tree. Gradient winds were gusting 20 to 30 MPH at the time.
Rapides 911 reports a tree down on an apartment building on Dublin Rd in Alexandria. ASOS at nearby Alexandria airport reported a maximum wind gust of 41 MPH at 2:35 AM CDT.
Rapides 911 reports a tree down across Horseshoe road in Alexandria.
Public reported pea size hail on Lumas Rd.
